_env.flags: -O3 -march=native -std=c++17 -ffp-contract=off; g++ on Linux, pinned with taskset -c 4
_env.E1: 1000 queries per seed; one warm-up pass per method; then every query is timed once per method with the three methods interleaved per query; per-query thread CPU time (CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID, 41.67 ns tick) minus the calibrated clock overhead (median of an empty measured body), and wall time; stream = 1000 back-to-back queries, best of 3
_env.E2: 100,000 parcels per seed; one warm-up run per method, then E2_REPS repetitions with all methods interleaved inside each repetition; median per method reported; primary metric = thread CPU time (CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID), wall clock also recorded
